ops.title: Avoid hourly full-history recurrence scans in long-running
ops.description: Owner /root. User authorized next repair after clock indexing. Recur currently reads every CCI record for72h hourly, even when no installation needs counting; rereads fixture directories and recomputes already published results. Reuse indexed lane queries and existing recurrence identities to read only work not yet reported, preserving exact24h count/report behavior. Next inspect CCI filtered query and existing report identity, add bounded hosted regressions, merge/release/install/verify actual runtime. No local replay/load/stress tests; other campaign work stays held. No further model worker authorization beyond exhausted previous reviewer.

ops.text: No full-drive history query when no recurrence report is due, and completed reports are not recomputed
Exact report content and24h boundary behavior preserved, hosted regression checks green
Merged signed release installed and running locally; real passive verification recorded
